title: Absence of Natural Multi-Speaker Conversational Continuous Holdout
description: The current test fixtures (phase6_1a_holdout_manifest.csv) are synthesized from isolated speech or re-recordings with overlapping speaker identity to training corpora. A statistically valid, clean holdout requires an unexposed human field recording campaign across Northern, Central, and Southern dialects.
impact: Generalization to arbitrary live speaker environments remains unvalidated.
mitigation: Holdout manifest sealed (1,340 samples, SHA 251546a5...); evaluation deferred to Phase 9 post-field collection.

title: Open-Gate Conversational False Activation Non-Zero
description: Under continuous open microphone without session gating, Arm B exhibits 15.42 to 17.50 false activations per minute on natural Vietnamese conversation (though an 88% reduction from frozen v11's 133.33 FAR/min). The classifier cannot serve as an un-gated always-on voice trigger.
impact: Unintentional triggers if operated outside Game Mode session gating.
mitigation: Enforce GameModeSessionController closed-gate policy, achieving 0.0 false activations/minute.

title: Slaney Mel Filterbank Calibration Discrepancy
description: The legacy NumPy frontend used an HTK approximation for frequencies below 1000 Hz, causing ~4% label mismatch with PyTorch. Calibrated to use exact torchaudio Slaney fbanks, achieving max logit diff < 2e-5 and 100.0% parity.
impact: Resolved for Arm B ONNX runtime; future models must strictly inherit this exact frontend.
mitigation: Export and runtime scripts explicitly use verified torchaudio Slaney filterbank matrix.

title: Legacy v11 Remains Active Production Default
description: Arm B is validated and accepted as an experimental candidate for Game Mode only. Per system governance invariants, legacy_v11 remains the active production default path until field validation.
impact: No breaking changes to default production deployment.
mitigation: legacy_v11 default path preserved; Arm B accessible via explicit experimental candidate flag.
